description: Read-only probe BIG-VIDEO (owner 2026-11-19 allowed Telethon only for downloading videos over 20 MB; the owner sent a test video to the CRM bot). Bounded run in the existing private inbox: upload this package, run source_remote.py once in a temporary always-on task (removed after its receipt; never the CRM bot) which, inside the inbox folder bigvideo_probe_work only: installs Telethon 1.46.0 (+pyaes, rsa) there, logs in as the CRM bot over MTProto in memory with updates off (no logOut, the bot keeps running on the Bot API), finds the newest video over 20 MB from an owner by message number, downloads it to the temporary folder, measures size, duration, speed and CPU, then deletes the folder. Key and token values are never reported. No source, CRM, HTML, media or bot state change.
title: Big video download probe
